title: HB2579 (2023 Regular): Relating to transfers of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2579/Introduced; sha256 2726b4750ae2ee4674eaf6a5dd474b7e3d73fa621a2375f3274ca023a013d86a)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced), no votes recorded. Subsection (4)(e) is the addition per the digest; the rest of the section is existing law reprinted. The bill amends ORS 166.435 as amended by Measure 114 (chapter 1, Oregon Laws 2023), so the permit-to-purchase requirement is referenced.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (2) Except as provided in ORS 166.436 and 166.438 and subsection (4) of this section, a transferor may not transfer a firearm to a transferee unless the transfer is completed through a gun dealer as described in subsection (3) of this section.
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (4)(e) The transfer of a curio or relic, as that term is defined in 27 C.F.R. part 478.11, to a person licensed as a collector under 18 U.S.C. 923.
